text:
Ravi Singh: I've uploaded the postmortem for the vendor-auth + registry outage: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/1972500000. We need clear owners, discrete action items, and a plan to avoid the same cascade. Short summary: auth provider token rotation spike + our registry fallback route didn't trigger because of a mis-typed env var.

Nora Feldman: I can own vendor-auth workstreams: immediate alerting for token rotation failures, a limited fallback token flow, and a vendor SLA audit. Suggest alerts in 5 business days, fallback token in 10.

Diego Ramos: I'll take registry hardening: pre-warm read-replicas, add local model artifact cache + TTL, and add a circuit-breaker around registry requests. Estimate: initial config + infra test in 1 week, rollout in 2 weeks.

Alexei Morozov: I'll own observability and runbooks: create an "auth-token-rotation-failure" composite alert, add dashboard panels for token expiry counts, and update the incident playbook with vendor escalation steps. Can do alerts & dashboard in 4 days.

Ravi Singh: Nice. Let's make these concrete with tracker items and E2E owners. ops-bot, create tracker issues grouped under PM-6123 (postmortem actions).

ops-bot: Created TASK-7221 (Vendor auth alerting) owner=Nora Feldman due=1972504320; TASK-7222 (Fallback token flow design) owner=Nora Feldman due=1972507920; TASK-7223 (Registry circuit-breaker + cache) owner=Diego Ramos due=1972507920; TASK-7224 (Dashboards + runbook update) owner=Alexei Morozov due=1972503600. Links: https://tasks.redwood/TASK-7221..4 :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Quick ask: add a quarterly vendor review to TASK-7221 as a recurring subtask and include the vendor CSM direct contact in the runbook. Also add a canary plan to TASK-7223 so we can validate fallback in staging.

Nora Feldman: Confirmed. I'll add vendor CSM contact and propose quarterly review cadence. Also requesting API keys and a staging tenant from vendor for the fallback dry run. @Ravi can you escalate to the vendor account rep?

Ravi Singh: On it. I emailed the account rep and CSM, pasted ticket link: https://support.vendor/s/abc-987. ETA for keys: 2 business days per vendor.

Diego Ramos: For the circuit-breaker I'm proposing this pattern: if registry error rate > 5% for 60s OR 3 consecutive 502s, switch to local cache for reads, and reduce write traffic to queue. Posting config snippet in PR.

Alexei Morozov: Also adding a metric "registry_fail_chain" which tags when registry errors correlate with auth errors to detect cascade patterns. We'll need historical backfill to catch previous occurrences.

Product Bot: Product impact summary requested: please add product-visible regression notes and customer-facing status copy drafts to TASK-7222 so support/product comms can prepare.

Nora Feldman: Adding PR timeline: design doc by 1972502160, draft PR by 1972504320, tests/CI by 1972506000. Will flag blockers early.

Diego Ramos: Registry PR timeline: draft PR by 1972503000, staging canary by 1972504800, deploy to prod behind flag by 1972508400.

Alexei Morozov: Runbook tabletop scheduled for 1972503600 (invite to #eng-sre + #eng). I'll post the slide deck to the postmortem doc.

Maria Chen: Collating for the postmortem doc:
- Vendor auth alerts + fallback tokens (Nora) 1972504320 -> alerts live; 1972507920 -> implement fallback token
- Registry fallback + cache (Diego) 1972503000 -> PR; 1972508400 -> deploy behind flag
- Dashboards/runbook/tabletop (Alexei) 1972503600 -> tabletop runbook update live
- Quarterly vendor SLA audit (Nora + Infra) 1972505200 -> add to roadmap and recurring task
Please confirm these epoch targets or reply with blockers.

Ravi Singh: All good from my side. Main risk: vendor keys delay, and current PR review queue. We may need an expedited review window for these PRs.

Nora Feldman: Acknowledged. I'll request expedited reviews and mark high-priority in the tracker.

Diego Ramos: Flag: we'll need temporary increase in staging capacity to run canary at scale. @Infra team please advise.

Maria Chen: I'll raise infra capacity request and link to TASK-7223.

ops-bot: Updated TASK-7223 with label=needs-infra-review.

Alexei Morozov: Let's reconvene in 72 hours for a short sync in this thread and update statuses. If anyone hits a blocker, please @mention me or @Ravi. :rocket:
